technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Beeswax, Black 2, Iron Oxides, Silica. Delivering a high-fidelity Obsidian Void color profile (`#2B2B2C`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
